Business kaise aage badhaye

Bill bada karne ke liye har baar bolna zaroori nahi. Counter ke paas ek "saath mein le jaiye" shelf rakhiye.

1. Jo cheezein aksar saath bikti hain, unki jodi pehchaaniye. Bill book dekhiye.
2. Shelf billing counter ke paas rakhiye, aankh ki oonchai pe.
3. Chhota card lagaiye: kya kiske saath jaata hai, aur daam.
4. Har hafte jodi badliye. Jo bika, likhiye.

Save kar lijiye. Comment mein bataiye, aapki dukaan mein kaun si do cheezein saath bikti hain? 👇

Har customer ka bill thoda bada ho, iska ek seedha tareeka: billing counter ke paas "saath mein le jaiye" shelf.

1. Jodi chuniye: jo cheezein aksar saath kharidi jaati hain. Bill book mein dikh jayengi.
2. Jagah: wahi jahan grahak paise dete waqt khada hota hai. Aankh ki oonchai, haath ki pahunch.
3. Label: chhota card, kya kiske saath jaata hai aur daam. Grahak ko poochna na pade.
4. Har hafte badliye: jo bika likhiye, jo nahi bika wo hataiye.

Aaj hi counter ke paas ek jodi rakhiye.
